port_difficulty.why: Eleven lines: one EXEC CICS READ INTO the ACCTREC copybook record, then RETURN. No computation, no branching, no arithmetic.

blast_radius.why: Read only against ACCTDAT, so it cannot corrupt the file. A failed READ with no RESP handling abends loudly. Any consumer outside the tree is unseen.

units.driving_fact: Reads the ACCTDAT KSDS that PROGW writes, through the same ACCTREC layout copybook (contract edge, high confidence).

port_difficulty.why: Eleven lines and no arithmetic, but it writes a COMP-3 balance (S9(9)V99) into a fixed layout, so the port must encode packed decimal byte for byte, including the sign nibble.

blast_radius.why: Only writer of the ACCTDAT account file in the tree. A wrong record or a wrong packed sign would be silent and would reach every reader, including the nightly batch cycle, which is not in the tree. The CSD points at a TEST dataset, so real exposure is unconfirmed.

units.driving_fact: Writes the ACCTDAT KSDS with a money field in COMP-3. The nightly batch cycle, the stated must-not-break item, has no artifact in the tree, so its dependence on this record layout cannot be checked.
